content: जाड्यम् [जडस्य भावः ष्यञ्] .²1 Coldness, frigidity. .²2 Apathy, sluggishness, inactivity. .²3 Dulness of intellect, folly, stupidity; तज्जाड्यं वसुधाधिपस्य <ls>Bh. 2. 15</ls>; जाड्यं धियो हरति <ls n="Bh.">2. 23</ls>; जाड्यं ह्नीमति गण्यते <ls n="Bh. 2.">54</ls>. .²4 Tastelessness of the tongue.
